literal_meaning: ঘষা-মেজা করা সুন্দরী (artificially polished or made-up beautiful woman)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘষেমেজে সুন্দরী, মেকআপ ছাড়া কিছুই নয়।
গ্রামের মেলায় ঘষেমেজে সুন্দরীরা সবাইকে মোহিত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a ghashe-meje sundori, nothing without her makeup.
At the village fair, the painted beauties captivate everyone.
note: Refers to women who enhance their appearance artificially, often critiquing superficiality in Bengali culture.
